57302-spirits-do-return.title: Spirits Do Return
57302-spirits-do-return.creator: Ida Belle White
57302-spirits-do-return.description: A book by Ida Belle White. This book was written through the inspirational spirit of the well-known writer, Samuel L. Clemens—“Mark Twain.” As I have never before written a book, the reader will see that I have had help from an unseen force—from the Spirit World.

arxiv-2106-03429.title: Gauge dependence of spontaneous radiation spectrum in a time-dependent relativistic non-perturbative Coulomb field
arxiv-2106-03429.creator: Xue-Nan Chen, Yu-Hang Luo, Xiang-Song Chen
arxiv-2106-03429.description: Abstract The delicacy of gauge choice in calculating atomic transitions was first raised by Lamb and gave arise to intensive discussion as well as much controversy. These discussion and controversy focused on choosing a proper gauge for the electromagnetic wave that interacts with an atom.

arxiv-2106-10388.title: Upper bounds for critical probabilities in Bernoulli Percolation models
arxiv-2106-10388.creator: Pablo A. Gomes, Alan Pereira, Remy Sanchis
arxiv-2106-10388.description: Abstract We consider bond and site Bernoulli Percolation in both the oriented and the non-oriented cases on ℤ d \mathbb{Z}^{d} and obtain rigorous upper bounds for the critical points in those models for every dimension d ≥ 3 d\geq 3 . Keywords: upper bounds for percolation; critical tresholds; dynamical coupling.

arxiv-2205-15343.title: Quantum bridge states and sub-dimensional transports in quasicrystals
arxiv-2205-15343.creator: Junmo Jeon, SungBin Lee
arxiv-2205-15343.description: Abstract Exotic tiling patterns of quasicrystals have gotten a lot of attention for unique quantum phenomena such as critical state and multifractality. In this regard, finding new quasi-periodic tiling patterns and the relevant quantum states is one of the main interests in quasicrystals.

arxiv-2211-02568.title: Investigation of the solution of a system of partial differential equations with periodic coefficients
arxiv-2211-02568.creator: by A. Potier
arxiv-2211-02568.description: Abstract This is an English translation of a paper by the French physicist Alfred Potier (1840-1905) that originally appeared 150 years ago [A. Potier, “Recherches sur l’intégration d’un système d’équations aux différentielles partielles à coefficients périodiques,” Comptes Rendus de l’Association Française pour l’Avancement des Sciences (Bordeaux), vol. 1, pp. 255-272 (1872)].

arxiv-2211-14563.title: Who are you referring to? Coreference resolution in image narrations
arxiv-2211-14563.creator: Arushi Goel, Basura Fernando, Frank Keller, and Hakan Bilen School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh, UK CFAR, IHPC, A*STAR, Singapore.
arxiv-2211-14563.description: Abstract Coreference resolution aims to identify words and phrases which refer to same entity in a text, a core task in natural language processing. In this paper, we extend this task to resolving coreferences in long-form narrations of visual scenes.

arxiv-2304-12052.title: Coexisting single-particle excitations and octupole correlations in transitional nucleus 𝐑𝐚 𝟐𝟏𝟕 \mathbf{{}^{217}Ra}
arxiv-2304-12052.creator: Madhu, A. Y. Deo, Khamosh Yadav, Dhananjaya Sahoo, Y. Y. Wang, Y. K. Wang, J. Meng, Saket Suman, S. K. Tandel, A. Sharma, I. Ahmed, K. Katre, K. Rojeeta Devi, S. Dutt, S. Kumar, Yashraj, S. Muralithar, R. P. Singh
arxiv-2304-12052.description: Abstract The level structure of the transitional nucleus Ra 217 \mathrm{{}^{217}Ra} has been extended with the addition of around 20 new transitions. The discrepancies between the placements of several transitions reported in the earlier studies are resolved. The newly-established negative-parity sequence at low excitation energies hints at the expected parity-doublet structures in this nucleus.

arxiv-2311-12906.title: Nonlinear System Identification of Swarm of UAVs Using Deep Learning Methods
arxiv-2311-12906.creator: Saman Yazdannik, Morteza Tayefi, Mojtaba Farrokh
arxiv-2311-12906.description: Abstract This study designs and evaluates multiple nonlinear system identification techniques for modeling the UAV swarm system in planar space. learning methods such as RNNs, CNNs, and Neural ODE are explored and compared. The objective is to forecast future swarm trajectories by accurately approximating the nonlinear dynamics of the swarm model.

arxiv-2401-17224.title: Evolvable Agents, a Fine Grained Approach for Distributed Evolutionary Computing: Walking towards the Peer-to-Peer Computing Frontiers
arxiv-2401-17224.creator: J.L.J. Laredo, P.A. Castillo, A.M. Mora, J.J. Merelo
arxiv-2401-17224.description: Abstract In this work we propose a fine grained approach with self-adaptive migration rate for distributed evolutionary computation. Our target is to gain some insights on the effects caused by communication when the algorithm scales. To this end, we consider a set of basic topologies in order to avoid the overlapping of algorithmic effects between communication and topological structures.

arxiv-2402-07842.title: Exact lower bound of the uncertainty principle product for the harmonic oscillator with position-momentum coupling
arxiv-2402-07842.creator: Yamen Hamdouni
arxiv-2402-07842.description: Abstract We show that the uncertainty principle product for the position and momentum operators for a system described by the Hamiltonian H ^ = p ^ 2 2 ​ m + 1 2 ​ m ​ ω 2 ​ x ^ 2 + μ 2 ​ ( x ^ ​ p ^ + p ^ ​ x ^ ) \hat{H}=\frac{\hat{p}^{2}}{2m}+\frac{1}{2}m\omega^{2}\hat{x}^{2}+\frac{\mu}{2}(\hat{x}\hat{p}+\hat{p}\hat{x})

arxiv-2404-05820.title: Fluoride Frameworks as Potential Calcium Battery Cathodes
arxiv-2404-05820.creator: Dereje Bekele Tekliye, Gopalakrishnan Sai Gautam
arxiv-2404-05820.description: Abstract Calcium batteries (CBs) are potential next-generation energy storage devices, offering a promising alternative to lithium-ion batteries due to their theoretically high energy density, better safety, and lower costs associated with the natural abundance of calcium. However, the limited availability of positive electrode (cathode) materials has constrained the development of CBs so far.

arxiv-2411-17245.title: Smoothed Analysis of the k k -Swap Neighborhood for Makespan Scheduling
arxiv-2411-17245.creator: Lars Rohwedder, Ashkan Safari, Tjark Vredeveld
arxiv-2411-17245.description: Abstract Local search is a widely used technique for tackling challenging optimization problems, offering simplicity and strong empirical performance across various problem domains. In this paper, we address the problem of scheduling a set of jobs on identical parallel machines with the objective of makespan minimization , by considering a local search neighborhood, called k-swap .

arxiv-2506-11673.title: Improving Causal Interventions in Amnesic Probing with Mean Projection or LEACE
arxiv-2506-11673.creator: Alicja Dobrzeniecka, Antske Fokkens, Pia Sommerauer
arxiv-2506-11673.description: Abstract Amnesic probing is a technique used to examine the influence of specific linguistic information on the behaviour of a model. This involves identifying and removing the relevant information and then assessing whether the model’s performance on the main task changes. If the removed information is relevant, the model’s performance should decline.

arxiv-2602-00742.title: CURP: Codebook-based Continuous User Representation for Personalized Generation with LLMs
arxiv-2602-00742.creator: Liang Wang, Xinyi Mou, Xiaoyou Liu, Xuanjing Huang, Zhongyu Wei

arxiv-2606-16312.title: Foundations of entropy in complex systems
arxiv-2606-16312.creator: Jan Korbel

britannica-1911-penryn.title: Penryn (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-penryn.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-penryn.description: Article 'Penryn' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Penrith and the adjoining township of St Mary’s are chiefly remarkable for their connexion with the railway. The iron tubular bridge which carries the line over the Nepean is the best of its kind in the colony, while the viaduct over Knapsack Gulley is the most remarkable erection of its kind in Australia.

plaw-113-262-2014.description: Public Law 113-262 (2014): May 31, 1918 Act Repeal Act

plos-pone-0004584.creator: John Morlan, Joffre Baker, Dominick Sinicropi
plos-pone-0004584.description: PLOS ONE research article. Molecular tests for diagnosis of disease, particularly cancer, are gaining increased acceptance by physicians and their patients for disease prognosis and selection of treatment options. Gene expression profiles and genetic mutations are key parameters used for the molecular char

pmc-10551228.title: Asymptomatic atrial fibrillation among hospitalized patients: clinical correlates and in-hospital outcomes in Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-10551228.creator: Jing Lin, Xue-Ying Wu, De-Yong Long, Chen-Xi Jiang, Cai-Hua Sang, Ri-Bo Tang, Song-Nan Li, Wei Wang, Xue-Yuan Guo, Man Ning, Zhao-Qing Sun, Na Yang, Yong-Chen Hao, Jun Liu, Jing Liu, Xin Du, Gregg C Fonarow, Sidney C Smith, Gregory Y H Lip, Dong Zhao, Jian-Zeng Dong, Chang-Sheng Ma
pmc-10551228.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). AimsThe clinical correlates and outcomes of asymptomatic atrial fibrillation (AF) in hospitalized patients are largely unknown. We aimed to investigate the clinical correlates and in-hospital outcomes of asymptomatic AF in hospitalized Chinese patients.Methods and resultsWe conducted a cross-sectional registry study of inpatients with AF enrolled in the Improving Care for Cardiovascular Disease in China-Atrial Fibrillation Project between February 2015 and December 2019.

pmc-10649101.title: ERp29 Attenuates Nicotine-Induced Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Inhibits Choroidal Neovascularization
pmc-10649101.creator: Tu Lu, Fangfang Xie, Chuangxin Huang, Lijun Zhou, Kunbei Lai, Yajun Gong, Zijing Li, Longhui Li, Jiandong Liang, Qifeng Cong, Weihua Li, Rong Ju, Sarah X Zhang, Chenjin Jin, Stephanie C Joachim
pmc-10649101.description: Nicotine-induced endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress in retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) cells is thought to be one pathological mechanism underlying age-related macular degeneration (AMD). ERp29 attenuates tobacco extract-induced ER stress and mitigates tight junction damage in RPE cells. Herein, we aimed to further investigate the role of ERp29 in nicotine-induced ER stress and choroidal neovascularization (CNV).

pmc-11527826.title: Adherence and treatment discontinuation of oral semaglutide and once‐weekly semaglutide injection at 12 month follow‐up: Japanese real‐world data
pmc-11527826.creator: Takeshi Horii, Chikako Masudo, Yui Takayanagi, Yoichi Oikawa, Akira Shimada, Kiyoshi Mihara
pmc-11527826.description: Adherence and treatment continuation rates of the glucagon‐like peptide‐1 receptor agonist (GLP‐1RA) semaglutide for both oral (O‐SEMA) and subcutaneous injection (SEMA‐SC) remain unknown in real‐world clinical practice. This retrospective observational study compared the 12 month adherence and treatment discontinuation of O‐SEMA and once‐weekly SEMA‐SC in patients with type 2 diabetes using a real‐world claims database.

pmc-11641470.title: Effects of PEMF and LIPUS Therapy on the Expression of Genes Related to Peripheral Nerve Regeneration in Schwann Cells
pmc-11641470.creator: Mateusz Siwak, Danuta Piotrzkowska, Maciej Skrzypek, Ireneusz Majsterek
pmc-11641470.description: Peripheral nerve regeneration remains a major challenge in neuroscience, despite advancements in understanding its mechanisms. Current treatments, including nerve transplantation and drug therapies, face limitations such as invasiveness and incomplete recovery of nerve function. Physical therapies, like pulsed electromagnetic fields (PEMF) and low-intensity ultrasound (LIPUS), are gaining attention for their potential to enhance regeneration.

pmc-11645795.title: O025 Impact of Temporal Rhythms on Blood Pressure Variability: Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal Effects
pmc-11645795.creator: J Manners, H Scott, B Lechat, L Pinilla, M Perlis, R Adams, P Escourrou, D Eckert
pmc-11645795.description: IntroductionHigh blood pressure (BP) and BP variability are associated with increased risk of cardiovascular events and mortality. Despite known impacts of daily, weekly, and seasonal fluctuations on BP and BP variability, the independent temporal impacts are not well quantified, particularly in sleep research.

pmc-11714497.title: Cost‐effectiveness of an online randomised controlled trial for dementia prevention, Maintain Your Brain, to improve cognition and lower dementia risk after 3 years
pmc-11714497.creator: Heidi Welberry, Li‐Jung Elizabeth Ku, Sophy TF Shih, Louisa Jorm, Maria A. Fiatarone Singh, Michael Valenzuela, Jeewani Anupama Ginige, Megan Heffernan, Tiffany Chau, Henry Brodaty
pmc-11714497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe Maintain Your Brain (MYB) randomised controlled trial (RCT) examined the effect of a multi‐domain internet‐based dementia prevention program against a control group (information only) over three years among Australians aged 55‐77 years. A cost‐effective analysis (CEA) quantified the differences in costs (direct healthcare and program costs) and effectiveness outcomes between the intervention and control groups from a health care sector perspective.MethodAn economic evaluation was conducted alongside the MYB trial.

pmc-11972433.title: Young sanctuary-living chimpanzees produce more communicative expressions with artificial objects than with natural objects
pmc-11972433.creator: Violet Gibson, Derry Taylor, Sarah Salphati, Eszter Somogyi, Iris Nomikou, Marina Davila-Ross
pmc-11972433.description: In humans, interactions with objects are often embedded in communicative exchanges. Objects offer unique affordances to explore, carry functions and hold cultural relevance, which can shape children’s interactions and communication. Research indicates that the use of artificial objects, such as certain toys, helps promote pre-linguistic communication, consequently impacting language development.

pmc-12421068.title: Enhanced Angiogenic Potential of Electrically Stimulated Human Adipose‐Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) for Ischemic Tissue Regeneration
pmc-12421068.creator: Jongdarm Yi, Seungjun Lee, Chiseon Ryu, Gaeun Kim, Junghyun Kim, Jae Young Lee
pmc-12421068.description: Effective treatment of ischemic disease requires the reconstruction of blood vessels through the delivery of angiogenic factors, such as chemicals, proteins, and cells. In particular, substantial efforts have focused on enhancing the therapeutic potential of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) for treating ischemic diseases.

pmc-12435663.title: Integrating co-design into formative research for a SBCC entry-point platform for nutrition-sensitive social protection programs in low -and middle-income country settings
pmc-12435663.creator: Tahir Turk, Rina Paul, Nilofer Fatimi Safdar, Nadia Shah, Syed Mahbubul Alam, Sohel Reza Choudhury, Kashif Shafique, Zaeema Ahmer, Anthony Wenndt, Hamidullah Khan Babar, Tannaza Sadaf, Moniruzzaman Bipul, António Raposo, António Raposo, António Raposo
pmc-12435663.description: BackgroundAchieving adequate nutrition for vulnerable populations is an objective of the Sustainable Development Goals. Nutrition-sensitive social protection programs, including those that promote nutrition through Social and Behaviour Change Communication (SBCC), have the potential to reduce malnutrition and provide social supports to those most in need. Country-level needs assessments can clarify key issues.

pmc-12598885.title: Synthesis and crystal structure of bis­(levofloxacindiium) di­aqua­tetra-μ-chlorido-penta­chlorido­tricopper(II) chloride
pmc-12598885.creator: Mahbuba Ishquvvatovna Bozorova, Khayit Khudainazarovich Turaev, Bekmurod Khurramovich Alimnazarov, Abdusamat Abdujabborovich Rasulov, Bakhtiyar Tulyaganovich Ibragimov, Jamshid Mengnorovich Ashurov
pmc-12598885.description: A trinuclear copper(II)–levofloxacin complex, (C18H22FN3O4)2[Cu3Cl9(H2O)2]Cl, was synthesized and its crystal structure determined. It features five-coordinated CuII centres with Jahn–Teller distortion and a three-dimensional hydrogen-bonded supra­molecular network. Structure description Levofloxacin, the optically pure S-(−)-enanti­omer of ofloxacin, is a prototypical third-generation fluoro­quinolone anti­biotic.

pmc-13147127.title: Development and effectiveness of a digital health literacy improvement program (DHL-Up) for multicultural children and adolescents in South Korea: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-13147127.creator: Sinyoung Choi, Kyung-Sook Bang
pmc-13147127.description: PurposeDigital health literacy is essential for health management among children and adolescents, with multicultural youth being particularly vulnerable to challenges in accessing, appraising, and using digital health information. This study aimed to develop a digital health literacy improvement program (DHL-Up) tailored to multicultural children and adolescents and evaluate its effectiveness.

pmc-13240422.title: Brainstem Tuberculous Abscess in a 63‐Year‐Old Adult With Unrepaired Tetralogy of Fallot
pmc-13240422.creator: Jessica S. Yang, Flora Y. Kurtz, Hans H. Liu, Benjamin Ehrlich, Gbambele Kone
pmc-13240422.description: BackgroundTetralogy of Fallot (TOF) is a congenital heart anomaly usually corrected surgically in childhood. Reports of adults with unrepaired TOF indicate that they are at high risk of endocardial infections and sequelae such as distant abscesses.Case PresentationA 63‐year‐old man born and raised in Vietnam presented with unrepaired TOF and 5 days of dizziness, dysarthria, and left‐sided weakness.

pmc-13257233.title: Effect of Different Antioxidants on the Quality of Smoked and Air-Dried Top Mouth Culter
pmc-13257233.creator: Yujie Lei, Xiaomei Gao, Wei Yu, Yu Qiao, Sha Cai, Xin Li
pmc-13257233.description: To improve the fish quality of air-drying topmouth culter, this study was carried out to add 0.2 wt% of antioxidants (tebutylhydroquinone (TBHQ) and tea polyphenol (TP)) in combination with salt to salinate topmouth culter and to investigate the effect of antioxidants on the quality as well as structural characteristics of topmouth culter during air-drying at 25 °C for 24 h.

pmc-13314910.title: Unraveling the economics of pulmonary embolism care in a 23-year resource utilization study
pmc-13314910.creator: Pablo Alberto Cuartas, Claire Ferguson, Danylo Orlov, Dewi Sihaloho, Ron Shemtov, Solomon Seckler, Sherene E. Sharath, Panos Kougias
pmc-13314910.description: BackgroundThe systematic assessment of resource utilization in cost-intensive diseases such as pulmonary embolism (PE) is important to optimize health system efficiency. We examined the association between treatment modality, cost, and length of stay among inpatients diagnosed with PE.MethodsUsing data from the National Inpatient Sample (1998-2021), we performed a retrospective trend analysis.

pmc-13363196.title: Extreme atherogenic index of plasma (log[TG_max/HDL_min]) and prognosis in sepsis-associated acute kidney injury: A MIMIC-IV retrospective study
pmc-13363196.creator: Siyao Zeng, Hanxin Liu, Zhen Quan, Zhipeng Yao, Yu Zhang, Yue Li, Junbo Zheng, Hongliang Wang
pmc-13363196.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Sepsis-associated acute kidney injury (SA-AKI) substantially worsens clinical outcomes, yet reliable prognostic biomarkers remain limited. Dysregulation of lipid metabolism, particularly elevated triglycerides (TG) and decreased high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C), may mirror the severity of critical illness. In this retrospective cohort study based on the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV database, we investigated whether a logarithmic lipid ratio, log(TG_max/HDL_min), obtained during the first week of intensive care, predicts adverse outcomes among 1633 adults with SA-AKI.

pmc-13414151.title: Differential Susceptibility to OsHV-1 in Two Geographic Populations of Ark Clam (Scapharca broughtonii) Based on Transcriptomic and Proteomic Analysis
pmc-13414151.creator: Qin Liu, Shuyuan Lian, Zhuangzhuang Qiu, Yanfei Hou, Yu Zhou, Chenghua Li, Haipeng Liu, Lusheng Xin
pmc-13414151.description: Ostreid herpesvirus 1 (OsHV-1) is a major pathogen associated with summer mortality in bivalve mollusks, but the host-side determinants of susceptibility remain poorly characterized outside oysters. In this study, we compared the responses of Chinese (CS) and Korean (KS) populations of the ark clam Scapharca broughtonii to experimental OsHV-1 challenge.
